And the vertical arm is at rows 17-43... row 17 is the "ccc" row of the gem, and the arm is at column 48, which is the center column of the gem. So the arm is overlapping with the gem's ring.
To get to (24,48): 1 UP. Let's execute UP once and check whether all 4 gems get collected / the level completes.
